desc: A guest's outcome lost for good is a miss both games agree on, logged, under a 150 ms round trip (TTYD_NET_FAULTS delay 75 each way, paced at 60): hei_03's four Goombas shared by 2 games, player 2 plays Goombella, both press A at their own commands and guards (TTYD_P1_PRESS a@ac); the guest's game never sends its first outcome (TTYD_SYNC_HOLD_RESULT=1). Its beat tells the host's game it has passed it; a second later the host's game takes it as a miss, sends the miss as its own, and the guest's game logs that its own was overruled. Neither game waits for ever, the battle ends in both, and the progress is the same

the shared battle ends .*late outcomes taken as misses 1
